summary: Official Deribit completed-hour BTC/ETH DVOL common, relative and implied-versus-realized states routed four-asset Binance USD-M factor-neutral residual continuation/reversion across 960 preregistered candidates. Zero passed the 2022 development gate, so 2023 remained unopened. Best raw 12bp candidate had 76 trades, +0.9291% total return, 0.003400% geometric daily growth, PF 1.068, MDD 3.45%, negative median trade and -7.37% after removing the largest 10% positive trades; it lost at 18/24bp. Best candidate with at least 100 trades had 232 trades, +0.7606% at 12bp, -4.9605% at 18bp, -9.7742% at 24bp, negative median trade and -31.15% after top-10% removal. Current first place unchanged.
